```{r palettes, include=FALSE}
psrc_fill_dec <- list(
  Walk = psrc_colors$purples_dec[1:5],
  `Bike/Micromobility` = psrc_colors$oranges_dec[1:5],
  survey_year = psrc_colors$blues_dec[1:5],
  mode_class_5 = psrc_colors$greens_dec[1:5]
  )

psrc_fill_segment <- list(
  hhincome_bin = c("#91268F", "#8CC63E"),
  hhincome_detailed_combined = psrc_colors$pgnobgy_5,
  gender_group = c("#F05A28", "#00A7A0", "#91268F"),
  race_binary = c("#91268F", "#00A7A0"),
  race_simple = psrc_colors$pognbgy_10,
  age_condensed = psrc_colors$gnbopgy_5,
  home_county = psrc_colors$obgnpgy_10,
  in_rgc = c("#00A7A0", "#8CC63E"),
  res_type_group = c("#91268F", "#F05A28")
  )
```

```{r figure_output, include=FALSE}
# single category
single_cat_output <- function(tbl, mode){
  print(
    ggplot(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode), 
           aes(x=factor(survey_year), y=prop)) +
      geom_col(aes(fill = factor(survey_year)), 
               width=0.7 # narrows columns to 70% for more white space between columns
               ) +
      # add data value above each column
      geom_text(aes(label=scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)),
                vjust = -0.3 # mode text vertically upward so it sits above columns
                ) +
      # add thin grey horizontal line at 0
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#cbcbcb", linewidth = 0.3) +
      
      # Error Bar Toggle:
      # To switch error on and off using params (TRUE/FALSE)
      errorbar_switch(
        
        geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = prop - prop_moe, ymax = prop + prop_moe), width = 0.1), 
        
        on=params$errorbar # this reads the errorbar parameter from yaml header to include error bars or not
        ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + # add a 10% buffer at the top to prevent geom_text from clipping
      scale_fill_manual(values = psrc_fill_dec[[mode]]) + # Palette Mapping: select color vector in psrc_fill_dec color list
      psrc_style() + # apply PSRC formatting from psrcplot
      theme(legend.position = "none", # Removes the legend when colors map 1:1 to x-axis labels
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), # Removes horizontal gridlines
            axis.text.y = element_blank(), # Removes y-axis tick values
            axis.title = element_blank()) # Removes both X and Y titles (use axis.title.x = element_blank() to keep y-axis title)
  )
}

# multi category
multi_cat_output <- function(tbl, mode, group_var, type = "both"){
  if( type %in% c("year","both") ){
    
    # grouping by year
    df_plot <- ggplot(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode),
                      aes(x=mode, y=prop, fill=!!sym(group_var))) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge(), width=0.9) +
      geom_text(aes(label=scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)),
                    position = position_dodge(0.9),
                vjust = -0.3, 
                size = 10, size.unit="pt") +
      errorbar_switch(geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = prop - prop_moe, ymax = prop + prop_moe),
                                    position = position_dodge(0.9),
                                    width = 0.1), 
                      on=params$errorbar) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#cbcbcb", linewidth = 0.3) +
      facet_wrap(~ survey_year, ncol=5)+
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = psrc_fill_segment[[group_var]])+
      psrc_style() +
      theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 11), # adjust text size on legend
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.y = element_blank())

    print(df_plot)

  }

  if( type %in% c("cat","both") ){
    
    # grouping by category
    df_plot <- ggplot(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode),
                      aes(x=factor(survey_year), y=prop, fill=factor(survey_year))) +
      geom_col(width = 0.8) +
      geom_text(aes(label=scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)),
                vjust = -0.3) +
      errorbar_switch(geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = prop - prop_moe, ymax = prop + prop_moe),
                                    width = 0.1), 
                      on=params$errorbar) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#cbcbcb", linewidth = 0.3) +
      facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", group_var)), ncol=5)+
      scale_fill_manual(values = psrc_fill_dec[[mode]])+
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, 
                         expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      psrc_style() +
      theme(legend.position = "none", # remove legend
            strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5), # adjust text size on facet title (variable values)
            panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
            panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"), # add spacing between facet grids
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10.5), # adjust text size for axis text (years)
            axis.text.y = element_blank())

    print(df_plot)

  }
}
```

```{r tbl_output, include=FALSE}
tbl_output <- function(tbl, mode, group_var = NULL){
  if (is.null(group_var)){
    
    return(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode) %>% 
             mutate(prop = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
                    prop_moe = scales::percent(prop_moe, accuracy = 0.01),
                    est = scales::number(est, accuracy = 1, big.mark = ","),
                    count = scales::number(count, accuracy = 1, big.mark = ",")) %>%
             select(-est_moe) %>%
             rename(`survey year` = survey_year,
                    share = prop,
                    share_moe = prop_moe,
                    estimates = est,
                    sample = count) %>%
             knitr::kable()
    )
    
  } else {
    
    return(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode & group_var != "Prefer not to answer") %>% 
             mutate(prop = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1),
                    prop_moe = scales::percent(prop_moe, accuracy = 0.01),
                    est = scales::number(est, accuracy = 1, big.mark = ","),
                    count = scales::number(count, accuracy = 1, big.mark = ",")) %>%
             select(-est_moe) %>%
             rename(`survey year` = survey_year,
                    share = prop,
                    share_moe = prop_moe,
                    estimates = est,
                    sample = count) %>%
             knitr::kable()
           )
    
  }
}
```

                              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
                              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
                              plot.title = element_text(size = 24)
                            ))
    
  print(static_column_chart(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode),
                            x = "survey_year", y = "prop", fill = "survey_year",
                            ylabel = "% of Trips", xlabel = "Survey Year", title = paste(mode, "Trips - Share"),
                            moe = "prop_moe") + theme(
                              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
                              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
                              plot.title = element_text(size = 24)
                            ))
  
  return(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode))
  
}

## Walking and Bike/Micromobility Trips

- Number and share of walk trips in region is down from 2021
- Number and share of bike/micro trips in region is up from 2021

### Trips by Household Income

- Walk trips in 2025 for $50k-$150k groups are down from pre-COVID levels

summary_output <- function(tbl, mode){
  
  print(static_column_chart(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode),
                            x = "survey_year", y = "est", fill = "survey_year",
                            ylabel = "# of Trips", xlabel = "Survey Year", title = paste(mode, "Trips - Estimate"),
                            moe = "est_moe") + theme(
                              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
                              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
                              plot.title = element_text(size = 24)
                            ))
    
  print(static_column_chart(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode),
                            x = "survey_year", y = "prop", fill = "survey_year",
                            ylabel = "% of Trips", xlabel = "Survey Year", title = paste(mode, "Trips - Share"),
                            moe = "prop_moe") + theme(
                              axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
                              axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
                              axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
                              plot.title = element_text(size = 24)
                            ))
  
  return(filter(tbl, mode_class_5 == mode))
  
}
